newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX weighing N.Y.'s merger conditions.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX weighing N.Y.'s merger conditions.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp said they were pleased that the New York State Public Service Commission had voted to okay their merger deal but were still assessing the conditions attached to that approval.
In a joint statement, the companies also noted that approval at the federal level is taking longer than expected.

It said the U.S. Department of Justice and the U.S. Federal Communications Commission continue to review the proposed merger. It noted that the companies had been aiming to complete the merger by April.
In a separate statement issued by NYNEX, Don Reed, the company's president said "What we have here is a mixed bag."

While noting he was pleased that the N.Y. State Public Service Commission (NYPSC) had given its approval to the deal, he said that, "At the same time, the PSC has imposed rigorous conditions that must be carefully reviewed in order to assess their impact on our business.

"The commission created a laundry list of requirements and significant obligations that qualify its approval of this transaction," he said, adding these would affect its long-term regulatory status and near-term investment and hiring plans.
